title: Revoke approval authority when the reviewer loses project access
problem: The new approval gate uses `resolve_org_github_login_to_users`, which checks organization membership only. It does not check `User.is_active` or current private-project access. Settings rows and reviewer artifacts remain after access changes. A user can enable the toggle, lose access, and still authorize later Stamphog approvals. The user cannot clear the toggle after losing access.
suggestion: Intersect resolved reviewers with `team.all_users_with_access()` before reading the toggle. This queryset excludes inactive users and honors private-project access. Return `None` after access revocation in both the initial receiver and webhook resolver. Add cases for inactive and removed project members.
